faq.question: What does Kaveh mean?
faq.answer: Kaveh is associated with the Persian form كَاوِه, whose core sense is kaveh; a persian legendary hero.

faq.question: What is the origin of Kaveh?
faq.answer: Kaveh is associated with Persian. Kaveh is Persian کاوه (Kāveh), the name of a legendary hero in the Shahnameh. It is used as a male given name in Iran.

faq.question: Is Kaveh an Arabic name?
faq.answer: No — the underlying form is Persian, not Arabic.

faq.question: Is Kaveh an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Kaveh can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Persian-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.question: Is Kaveh a Quranic name?
faq.answer: Kaveh should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Kāveh is a Persian name, not a Quranic Arabic form.
